# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Local Development

Do not use Windows tooling. Use WSL and ASDF for development tasks, especially node and pnpm.

## Continuous Improvement

Suggest improvements to this instructions file as well as other documentation so that the next person to work on the project has an easier time.

## Gotchas

BeefBrain has a custom YAML filetype that is valid YAML, but has many special formatting and auto-calculation rules. These files should have a `*.bnb.yaml` double-extension.
